description: Figure 2 presents a bar chart illustrating the results of an ablation study on the INSPIRED dataset, evaluating the impact of removing specific components from the proposed recommendation system on the NDCG@10 metric. The horizontal axis displays four configurations: “Ours” (the complete model), “- critiquing” (removing attribute-based item critiquing), “- scoring” (removing generative item scoring), and “- ranking” (removing efficient candidate ranking). The vertical axis represents the NDCG@10 score, ranging from 0.05 to 0.25 with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The “Ours” bar, colored orange, reaches approximately 0.21. The “- critiquing” bar, in dark blue, is slightly lower at around 0.19. The “- scoring” bar, in a lighter blue, shows a significant drop to approximately 0.07. The “- ranking” bar, also in dark blue, is at about 0.12. The chart visually demonstrates that removing generative item scoring causes the most substantial performance degradation, followed by removing efficient ranking, while removing critiquing has a comparatively smaller negative effect. The caption clarifies that “critiquing” refers to attribute-based item critiquing, “scoring” to generative item scoring, and “ranking” to efficient candidate ranking.
